text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Make Debut had finally 
arrived. Duramente was drawing as much 
attention as ever, surrounded by a swarm 
of reporters.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
With your debut just around the corner, 
please tell us your honest feelings right 
now!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Nothing in particular.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so? Uhm... So it means I'm 
keeping my composure, right!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"You'll definitely win with ease! This is 
where your legend begins... Just like the 
rest of your family!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
The one I remember most vividly is 
definitely your father!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Father left behind an overwhelming record 
in the decathlon... It was so incredible 
that it sent shockwaves across all of 
Japan.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"At the press conference the other day, 
you mentioned you're aiming for the world 
stage. We look forward to seeing you make 
a powerful statement with a commanding 
debut!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Of course. Coursing through my veins is 
the blood of an athlete who continually 
challenges the world—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I will prove that this bloodline is the 
real deal.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Once we start, first watch how things 
unfold. See what they do, then break away 
on the final stretch in one go.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes... push them away. Completely, right 
from the start.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the surface, she seems fired up. 
However, the words spoken to her have 
likely turned into a curse.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: A flawless, perfect victory......—
choice_data_list: "It doesn't have to be perfect at first."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
Even the horse girls and all of us whom 
you respect... None of us were called the 
strongest right from the start.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes slacking on preparations, 
sometimes having my weaknesses exploited. 
Sometimes nervous out of my mind... Little 
by little, I grew stronger.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Duramente's father told her when she 
tried to hide her nervousness before... It 
must have resonated deeply within her 
heart.
choice_data_list:
Your road to becoming the strongest starts 
here, right?

Your road to becoming the strongest starts 
here, right?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Right, that was it.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Phew...—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'm fine now.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I'm going.
